intro.title: Welcome to beide
intro.lead: An IDE with a coding agent inside: a plan before it acts, a diff before it writes, a checkpoint before it changes anything. Give it a try — it takes a minute.

onboarding.sub: Monaco · Plan / Agent · diff before writes · checkpoints. GPT, Claude, Gemini and more — from the cloud after sign-in.
onboarding.welcomeLead: Open a folder, write in Monaco, the agent lives on the right. Plan only explores; Agent can edit files under your control.
onboarding.heroWindowsBody: Electron + Monaco + xterm — a desktop shell without browser workarounds.
onboarding.heroNoMarketBody: Focused on the agent and your code, not an extension store.
onboarding.featuresLead: Two modes — exploration and execution. The switch lives in the chat header.
onboarding.featurePlanBody: Reads the repository and writes a plan. Never touches files.
onboarding.featureAgentBody: Edit / write / bash. Dangerous actions only after your ok.
onboarding.featureContextBody: @file, images, the workspace tree — the agent sees the project.
onboarding.settingsLead: Set the theme, language, and permissions now. Later — in Settings.
onboarding.themeHint: Applies immediately while you are in onboarding
onboarding.permissionsHint: We recommend ask for new projects
onboarding.accountLead: Sign-in is required: usage limits and model access are tied to your account. The provider key arrives from the cloud automatically.
onboarding.sessionRestored: Session restored. Continue or switch accounts.
onboarding.signOutSwitch: Sign out and use another account
onboarding.passwordPlaceholder: at least 8 characters: upper/lowercase letters and digits
